_comment: Example config for Mobile AI Server Switch. Copy this file to ~/.config/mobileserverswitch/config.json and edit it there -- this file itself is never read by the CLIs. Any section/key you omit falls back to its default (usually "auto" = runtime auto-detection). Remove this _comment key in your own copy if you like; it is ignored by the CLIs either way.

network._comment: "auto" runs live detection on every read. Only override a value here if detection picks the wrong interface/zone on your system.

_services_examples._comment: Copy entries from _services_examples into the services array to enable them. Each entry needs id (stable key), label (shown in the Services tab), unit (systemd unit name), scope (user or system), and port (for the exposure check).

mode._comment: Legacy fallback: charge_thresholds and stop_on_laptop are only read when the config has NO "profiles" key. New configs should use the profiles map below instead.

profiles._comment: Switchable profiles: 'msw-mode list' shows them all, 'msw-mode <id>' activates one. Every key is optional -- omit it, set it to null, or use "keep" to leave that aspect untouched when switching. The two defaults are meant to be edited; add your own profiles as extra keys in this map (id: lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Enums: lid_action/power_button/power_button_long/auto_suspend: ignore|sleep|shutdown|prompt|keep; wol/wifi/bluetooth: on|off|keep; screen_off_min/dim_min: null = keep, 0 = never, N = minutes; charge_thresholds: "NN/NN" or null; performance.profile: power-saver|balanced|performance|null; dgpu: null|keep|auto ("keep" keeps the dGPU awake). Machine-level parts are re-applied at boot.

features._comment: Show/hide whole tabs. Overview is always shown.
